title: Prove an unbounded FULL/QUERY controller ceiling (no κ gain)
head: 314b56a6c0056c2358538f072c6fde9d365be44d
body:
This scoped proof puts a ceiling on the entire prefix/suffix FULL/QUERY invoice family with the current owned local profile: **no pair count, split or stage mask can fund `0.00302728825 <= κ < 1` through its strict moment test. No higher κ is claimed.** This removes the pair-count and stage-neighborhood limits of the earlier checks.

The [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/314b56a6c0056c2358538f072c6fde9d365be44d/research/global-query-controller-ceiling/PROOF.md), [exact receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/314b56a6c0056c2358538f072c6fde9d365be44d/research/global-query-controller-ceiling/RESULT.json), [verifier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/314b56a6c0056c2358538f072c6fde9d365be44d/research/global-query-controller-ceiling/verify.py) and [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/314b56a6c0056c2358538f072c6fde9d365be44d/research/global-query-controller-ceiling/SOURCES.json) define the review object. The current complete conditional comparison is **κ = 0.00302728823**, from [PR #5398](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5398), with [independent validation in PR #5400](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5400). Its remaining room in this family is less than `2e-11`; this package does not rerun that positive admission.

The proof fixes the local paid/helper profiles, 112 ports, rank-eight stage blocks, rank-one query price and prefix/suffix idle law. A concavity bound rejects every allocation with at least 96 FULL stages. Deleting pairs of QUERY stages reduces the remaining unbounded family to at most 96 pairs. An integer dynamic program checks all **10,290,000** remaining state combinations. The minimum certified paid-minus-target margin is greater than **0.000000014914967918767741908079**, at the current p16/a7 invoice. A separate monotonicity argument extends the sign from the tested saving to the full stated interval.

This covers all masks and all pair counts, unlike the at-most-two-stage screen in [PR #5393](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5393). [PR #5397](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5397) supplies the related fixed 144-exchange invoice ceiling. It does not exclude another native profile, connection graph, idle law or recursive contract. In particular, the coupled outputs of [PR #5402](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5402) require a different completed caller and are outside this theorem.

Base: canonical main `1ec1119972c9aefe42525172d07b332fcff81cb4`, priority 7. The exact [PR #5392](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5392) result at `329b2ff35d2994b11abbb59f770d12da75c494ac` is retained byte for byte in this branch's ancestor `6919161525e69b687630cb6468aa32b9414d7206`. Replay needs no pending predecessor checkout. The selected frontier is unchanged.

Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/global-query-controller-ceiling
```

Expected result in both registered modes:

```text
PASS_GLOBAL_QUERY_CONTROLLER_CEILING_NO_KAPPA_GAIN
```

Normal and optimized registered replays pass. Checks include source authentication, exact outward rational arithmetic, the infinite-tail inequalities, the complete dynamic program, 15 exact Laurent factorizations and all 12,744 masks through five pairs. The literal invoices and exhaustive minima agree with the new formula and dynamic program. Controls detect an omitted idle that falsely funds the moment, unearned helper credit and the middle-idle charge at an even FULL stage. All 16 committed-file bindings and official export integrity pass. An optimized read-only replay with Git absent passes; all 17 exported files remain unchanged. The optional full-history check is unavailable in this shallow checkout; direct base and retained-source ancestry checks pass. Hosted CI is pending at publication.

The native phase suite, complete compiler/outer and selected cold replays, physical tape execution and formal kernel were not run. The cited positive bounds retain the five selected framework assumptions. This is an author-checked mathematical ceiling for the stated invoices, not a global circuit optimum or a new multiplication theorem.
